draft.summary: On 21 October 2026, the Commission opened a consultation on bio-based plastic packaging. The results will inform an assessment of the technological development and environmental performance of bio-based plastic packaging.

21 October 2026
Commission opens consultation on bio-based plastic packaging
The results will inform an assessment of the technological development and environmental performance of bio-based plastic packaging.
